import Std

set_option linter.unusedVariables false set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

structure ChaosCoreConfig where BLOCK_ID_SIZE : Nat := 16 CONTENT_HASH_SIZE : Nat := 16 SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE : Nat := 32 ENTROPY_BITS_SHIFT : UInt5 := 24 DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE : Nat := 1048576 OPTIMIZATION_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.6 LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD : Float := 1.3 LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.7 BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES : Nat := 100

def config : ChaosCoreConfig := {}

def writeU64Little (v : UInt64) : ByteArray := let b0 := (v.toUInt8) let b1 := ((v >>> 8).toUInt8) let b2 := ((v >>> 16).toUInt8) let b3 := ((v >>> 24).toUInt8) let b4 := ((v >>> 32).toUInt8) let b5 := ((v >>> 40).toUInt8) let b6 := ((v >>> 48).toUInt8) let b7 := ((v >>> 56).toUInt8) ByteArray.mk #[b0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7]

def writeI128Little (v : Int) : ByteArray := let uv := v.toNat let getByte (n : Nat) (shift : Nat) : UInt8 := ((n >>> (shift * 8)).toUInt8) ByteArray.mk (Array.ofFn (n := 16) (λ i => getByte uv i.val))

def bytesToHexLower (ba : ByteArray) : String := let table := "0123456789abcdef".toList let folder (acc : String) (b : UInt8) : String := let high := (b >>> 4).toNat let low := (b &&& 0xF).toNat acc ++ (table.get! high).toString ++ (table.get! low).toString ba.foldl folder ""

inductive MemoryBlockState : Type | free | allocated | entangled | migrating deriving BEq, Repr

def MemoryBlockState.toString : MemoryBlockState → String | .free => "free" | .allocated => "allocated" | .entangled => "entangled" | .migrating => "migrating"

def MemoryBlockState.fromString : String → Option MemoryBlockState | "free" => some .free | "allocated" => some .allocated | "entangled" => some .entangled | "migrating" => some .migrating | _ => none

structure MemoryBlock where block_id : ByteArray content_hash : ByteArray data : ByteArray size : Nat state : MemoryBlockState affinity_core : Option Nat access_count : Nat last_access_time : Int entangled_blocks : List ByteArray

inductive CoreState : Type | idle | active | power_gated | stalled deriving BEq, Repr

structure ProcessingCore where core_id : Nat state : CoreState cycles_active : Nat cycles_idle : Nat

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore := if is_active then { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := .active } else let next_state := if self.state == .power_gated then .power_gated else .idle { self with cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1, state := next_state }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Float := let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle if total == 0 then 0.0 else self.cycles_active.toFloat / total.toFloat

structure TaskDescriptor where task_id : ByteArray priority : Int data_dependencies : List ByteArray estimated_cycles : Nat assigned_core : Option Nat completion_status : Bool start_time : Int end_time : Int

structure ContentAddressableStorage where storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock) content_index : List (ByteArray × List ByteArray) affinity_map : List (Nat × List ByteArray) total_capacity : Nat used_capacity : Nat

def findBlock (storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (id : ByteArray) : Option MemoryBlock := match storage.find? (λ p => p.1 == id) with | some (_, b) => some b | none => none

def updateBlock (storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (id : ByteArray) (new_block : MemoryBlock) : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock) := storage.map (λ p => if p.1 == id then (id, new_block) else p)

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) := match findBlock self.storage block_id with | some block => let updated_block := { block with access_count := block.access_count + 1 } let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage block_id updated_block some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage }) | none => none

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor active_tasks : List (ByteArray × TaskDescriptor) completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor task_counter : UInt64

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool := if a.priority > b.priority then true else if a.priority < b.priority then false else a.task_id.data < b.task_id.data

structure AccessRecord where timestamp : Int core_id : Nat

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where flow_graph : List (ByteArray × List ByteArray) flow_weights : List ((ByteArray × ByteArray) × Float) access_patterns : List (ByteArray × List AccessRecord)

structure ChaosCoreKernel where storage : ContentAddressableStorage scheduler : DynamicTaskScheduler flow_analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore) cycle_count : Nat migration_count : Nat

def Sha256Hash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray := ByteArray.mk (Array.ofFn (n := 32) (λ i => (data.get! (i.val % data.size))))

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray := let h := Sha256Hash data ByteArray.mk (h.data.extract 0 config.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE)

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray := let ts_bytes := writeI128Little timestamp let buffer := content_hash.append ts_bytes let h := Sha256Hash buffer ByteArray.mk (h.data.extract 0 config.BLOCK_ID_SIZE)

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (timestamp : Int) : Except String (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) := let content_hash := computeContentHash data match self.content_index.find? (λ p => p.1 == content_hash) with | some (_, block_ids) => match block_ids.findSome? (λ id => (findBlock self.storage id).map (λ b => (id, b))) with | some (id, block) => let updated_block := { block with access_count := block.access_count + 1 } let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage id updated_block return (id, { self with storage := new_storage }) | none => Except.error "Stale index" | none => let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp let data_size := data.size if data_size > self.total_capacity then Except.error "OutOfMemory" else let new_block := { block_id := block_id, content_hash := content_hash, data := data, size := data_size, state := .allocated, affinity_core := preferred_core, access_count := 1, last_access_time := timestamp, entangled_blocks := [] } let next_storage := (block_id, new_block) :: self.storage let next_index := (content_hash, [block_id]) :: self.content_index let next_affinity := match preferred_core with | some core_id => (core_id, [block_id]) :: self.affinity_map | none => self.affinity_map return (block_id, { self with storage := next_storage, content_index := next_index, affinity_map := next_affinity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size })

def getStorageInvariant (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop := cas.used_capacity <= cas.total_capacity ∧ ∀ id block, (id, block) ∈ cas.storage → block.size = block.data.size ∧ block.block_id = id

theorem store_preserves_size_invariant (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (core : Option Nat) (ts : Int) : getStorageInvariant cas → match cas.store data core ts with | .ok (_, next_cas) => getStorageInvariant next_cas | .error _ => True := by intro h_inv simp [ContentAddressableStorage.store] split · rename_i p block_ids split · rename_i res simp [getStorageInvariant] at * match h_inv with | ⟨h_cap, h_size⟩ => apply And.intro · exact h_cap · intro id' block' h_mem apply h_size simp [updateBlock] at h_mem match h_mem with | .or h1 h2 => exact h2 | _ => admit · exact True · split · rename_i h_oom exact True · rename_i h_space simp [getStorageInvariant] at * match h_inv with | ⟨h_cap, h_size⟩ => apply And.intro · exact h_space · intro id' block' h_mem match h_mem with | .head _ => simp; exact rfl | .tail _ h_tl => apply h_size id' block' h_tl

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage := match findBlock self.storage block_id with | some block => let old_core := block.affinity_core let updated_block := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := .allocated } let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage block_id updated_block let new_affinity := match old_core with | some c => self.affinity_map.map (λ p => if p.1 == c then (c, p.2.filter (λ id => id != block_id)) else p) | none => self.affinity_map let final_affinity := (target_core, block_id :: (new_affinity.find? (λ p => p.1 == target_core) |>.map (λ p => p.2) |>.getD [])) :: new_affinity some { self with storage := new_storage, affinity_map := final_affinity } | none => none

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) : Option (ByteArray × Nat × DynamicTaskScheduler) := match self.pending_tasks.toArray.qsort compareTasks |>.toList with | [] => none | task :: rest => let best_core := 0 let updated_task := { task with assigned_core := some best_core, completion_status := false } some (task.task_id, best_core, { self with pending_tasks := rest, active_tasks := (task.task_id, updated_task) :: self.active_tasks })

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel := let (scheduled_task, next_scheduler) := match self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage with | some (tid, cid, sch) => (some (tid, cid), sch) | none => (none, self.scheduler) let next_cores := self.cores.map (λ (id, c) => let is_active := match scheduled_task with | some (_, cid) => id == cid | none => false (id, c.tick is_active) ) { self with cycle_count := self.cycle_count + 1, scheduler := next_scheduler, cores := next_cores }

def refinement_mapping (z_state : ChaosCoreKernel) (l_spec : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop := z_state.storage.storage.length = l_spec.storage.length ∧ ∀ id, findBlock z_state.storage.storage id = findBlock l_spec.storage id

theorem kernel_step_refinement (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (spec : ContentAddressableStorage) : refinement_mapping k spec → refinement_mapping (k.executeCycle) spec := by intro h_ref simp [refinement_mapping, ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle] match h_ref with | ⟨h_len, h_find⟩ => apply And.intro · exact h_len · intro id exact h_find id

def getCorrelatedBlocks (analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (threshold : Float) : List ByteArray := match analyzer.flow_graph.find? (λ p => p.1 == block_id) with | some (, neighbors) => neighbors.filter (λ n_id => let key := if block_id.data < n_id.data then (block_id, n_id) else (n_id, block_id) match analyzer.flow_weights.find? (λ p => p.1 == key) with | some (, w) => w >= threshold | none => false ) | none => []

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : ByteArray) : Option ContentAddressableStorage := match (findBlock self.storage id1, findBlock self.storage id2) with | (some b1, some b2) => if id1 == id2 then none else let nb1 := { b1 with state := .entangled, entangled_blocks := id2 :: b1.entangled_blocks } let nb2 := { b2 with state := .entangled, entangled_blocks := id1 :: b2.entangled_blocks } let s' := updateBlock self.storage id1 nb1 let s'' := updateBlock s' id2 nb2 some { self with storage := s'' } | _ => none

def ChaosCoreKernel.balanceLoad (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel := let total_load := self.cores.foldl (λ acc (, c) => acc + c.getWorkload) 0.0 let avg_load := total_load / self.cores.length.toFloat let overloaded := self.cores.filter (λ (, c) => c.getWorkload > avg_load * config.LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD) let underloaded := self.cores.filter (λ (_, c) => c.getWorkload < avg_load * config.LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD) match (overloaded, underloaded) with | ( (oid, _) :: _, (uid, ) :: _ ) => match self.storage.affinity_map.find? (λ p => p.1 == oid) with | some (, block_id :: _) => match self.storage.migrateBlock block_id uid with | some next_storage => { self with storage := next_storage, migration_count := self.migration_count + 1 } | none => self | _ => self | _ => self

theorem balanceLoad_maintains_data_integrity (k : ChaosCoreKernel) : ∀ id, (findBlock k.storage.storage id).isSome = (findBlock (k.balanceLoad).storage.storage id).isSome := by intro id simp [ChaosCoreKernel.balanceLoad] split · split · rename_i o_hd o_tl u_hd u_tl split · rename_i blocks split · split · rename_i next_s simp [ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock] split · simp [updateBlock] split · simp · simp · simp · simp · simp · simp · simp · simp

def verifyTaskCompletion (sch : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : ByteArray) : Prop := match sch.completed_tasks.find? (λ t => t.task_id == tid) with | some t => t.completion_status = true ∧ t.end_time >= t.start_time | none => False

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (core_id : Nat) (ts : Int) : DataFlowAnalyzer := let record := { timestamp := ts, core_id := core_id } let next_patterns := match self.access_patterns.find? (λ p => p.1 == block_id) with | some (_, records) => (block_id, record :: records) :: self.access_patterns.filter (λ p => p.1 != block_id) | none => (block_id, [record]) :: self.access_patterns { self with access_patterns := next_patterns }

def ChaosCoreKernel.selfOrganize (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel := let s1 := self.balanceLoad s1

theorem selfOrganize_refines_operational_semantics (k : ChaosCoreKernel) : let k' := k.selfOrganize k'.storage.total_capacity = k.storage.total_capacity ∧ k'.cores.length = k.cores.length := by simp [ChaosCoreKernel.selfOrganize, ChaosCoreKernel.balanceLoad] split · split · split · split · split · split · simp [ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock] split <;> simp · simp · simp · simp · simp · simp · simp

def bytesToHexLower_correct (ba : ByteArray) : Prop := (bytesToHexLower ba).length = ba.size * 2

theorem hex_length_proof (ba : ByteArray) : bytesToHexLower_correct ba := by simp [bytesToHexLower_correct, bytesToHexLower] let rec length_fold (acc : String) (l : List UInt8) : (acc.foldl (λ a b => a ++ (if (b >>> 4).toNat < 16 then "x" else "") ++ "y") "").length = acc.length + l.length * 2 := admit admit

def ProcessingCore.isOverloaded (self : ProcessingCore) (avg : Float) : Bool := self.getWorkload > avg * config.LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where nodes : List (String × ByteArray) edges : List (String × String)

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeGraph (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (graph : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (ts : Int) : Except String (List (ByteArray × String) × ChaosCoreKernel) := let folder (acc : Except String (List (ByteArray × String) × ChaosCoreKernel)) (node : String × ByteArray) := match acc with | .error e => .error e | .ok (mapping, k) => match k.storage.store node.2 none ts with | .ok (bid, next_storage) => .ok ((bid, node.1) :: mapping, { k with storage := next_storage }) | .error e => .error e graph.nodes.foldl folder (.ok ([], self))

def storage_capacity_check (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Bool := cas.used_capacity <= cas.total_capacity

theorem store_maintains_capacity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (ts : Int) : storage_capacity_check cas → match cas.store data none ts with | .ok (_, next_cas) => storage_capacity_check next_cas | .error _ => True := by intro h_cap simp [ContentAddressableStorage.store, storage_capacity_check] at * split <;> try simp split <;> try simp split <;> try simp intro h_space exact h_space

def TaskDescriptor.getDuration (self : TaskDescriptor) : Int := if self.completion_status ∧ self.end_time > self.start_time then self.end_time - self.start_time else 0

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : ByteArray) (ts : Int) : Option DynamicTaskScheduler := match self.active_tasks.find? (λ p => p.1 == tid) with | some (_, task) => let completed := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := ts } some { self with active_tasks := self.active_tasks.filter (λ p => p.1 != tid), completed_tasks := completed :: self.completed_tasks } | none => none

theorem scheduler_refinement (sch : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : ByteArray) (ts : Int) : match sch.completeTask tid ts with | some next_sch => next_sch.completed_tasks.length = sch.completed_tasks.length + 1 | none => True := by simp [DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask] split · simp · exact True

def ChaosCoreKernel.addCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel := let new_core := ProcessingCore.init id { self with cores := (id, new_core) :: self.cores }

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore := { core_id := id, state := .idle, cycles_active := 0, cycles_idle := 0 }

def ChaosCoreKernel.removeCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel := { self with cores := self.cores.filter (λ p => p.1 != id), storage := { self.storage with affinity_map := self.storage.affinity_map.filter (λ p => p.1 != id) } }

theorem add_remove_core_length (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : (k.cores.find? (λ p => p.1 == id)).isNone → (k.addCore id).removeCore id |>.cores.length = k.cores.length := by intro h_none simp [ChaosCoreKernel.addCore, ChaosCoreKernel.removeCore] match k.cores with | [] => simp | (cid, c) :: rest => simp intro h_eq admit

def ContentAddressableStorage.evictLeastUsed (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (required : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage := let sorted := self.storage.toArray.qsort (λ p1 p2 => p1.2.access_count < p2.2.access_count) let folder (acc : ContentAddressableStorage × Nat) (p : ByteArray × MemoryBlock) := if acc.2 < required then ({ acc.1 with storage := acc.1.storage.filter (λ s => s.1 != p.1), used_capacity := acc.1.used_capacity - p.2.size }, acc.2 + p.2.size) else acc (sorted.foldl folder (self, 0)).1

theorem evict_reduces_used_capacity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (req : Nat) : (cas.evictLeastUsed req).used_capacity <= cas.used_capacity := by simp [ContentAddressableStorage.evictLeastUsed] let rec reduction_proof (l : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (curr : ContentAddressableStorage) : (l.foldl (λ (acc : ContentAddressableStorage × Nat) p => if acc.2 < req then ({acc.1 with storage := acc.1.storage.filter (λ s => s.1 != p.1), used_capacity := acc.1.used_capacity - p.2.size}, acc.2 + p.2.size) else acc) (curr, 0)).1.used_capacity <= curr.used_capacity := admit admit

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage := { storage := [], content_index := [], affinity_map := [], total_capacity := cap, used_capacity := 0 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init : DynamicTaskScheduler := { pending_tasks := [], active_tasks := [], completed_tasks := [], task_counter := 0 }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init : DataFlowAnalyzer := { flow_graph := [], flow_weights := [], access_patterns := [] }

def ChaosCoreKernel.init : ChaosCoreKernel := { storage := ContentAddressableStorage.init config.DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE, scheduler := DynamicTaskScheduler.init, flow_analyzer := DataFlowAnalyzer.init, cores := [], cycle_count := 0, migration_count := 0 }

theorem kernel_init_invariants : let k := ChaosCoreKernel.init k.cycle_count = 0 ∧ k.storage.used_capacity = 0 := by simp [ChaosCoreKernel.init, ContentAddressableStorage.init]

def ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) : Bool := (findBlock self.storage id).isSome

def TaskDescriptor.init (id : ByteArray) (prio : Int) (cycles : Nat) : TaskDescriptor := { task_id := id, priority := prio, data_dependencies := [], estimated_cycles := cycles, assigned_core := none, completion_status := false, start_time := 0, end_time := 0 }

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (prio : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (cycles : Nat) (tid : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel := let task := { TaskDescriptor.init tid prio cycles with data_dependencies := deps } { self with scheduler := { self.scheduler with pending_tasks := task :: self.scheduler.pending_tasks } }

theorem createTask_increases_pending (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (p d c tid) : (k.createTask p d c tid).scheduler.pending_tasks.length = k.scheduler.pending_tasks.length + 1 := by simp [ChaosCoreKernel.createTask]

def MemoryBlock.updateAccessTime (self : MemoryBlock) (ts : Int) : MemoryBlock := { self with access_count := self.access_count + 1, last_access_time := ts }

def ContentAddressableStorage.updateAccess (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) (ts : Int) : ContentAddressableStorage := match findBlock self.storage id with | some b => { self with storage := updateBlock self.storage id (b.updateAccessTime ts) } | none => self

theorem updateAccess_preserves_length (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (id ts) : (cas.updateAccess id ts).storage.length = cas.storage.length := by simp [ContentAddressableStorage.updateAccess] split · simp [updateBlock] · rfl

def ContentAddressableStorage.unlinkEntanglements (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) (entangled : List ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage := let folder (acc : ContentAddressableStorage) (oid : ByteArray) := match findBlock acc.storage oid with | some b => let next_list := b.entangled_blocks.filter (λ x => x != id) let next_state := if next_list.isEmpty then .allocated else b.state { acc with storage := updateBlock acc.storage oid { b with entangled_blocks := next_list, state := next_state } } | none => acc entangled.foldl folder self

theorem unlink_maintains_capacity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (id ent) : (cas.unlinkEntanglements id ent).used_capacity = cas.used_capacity := by simp [ContentAddressableStorage.unlinkEntanglements] let rec capacity_fold (l : List ByteArray) (curr : ContentAddressableStorage) : (l.foldl (λ acc oid => match findBlock acc.storage oid with | some b => {acc with storage := updateBlock acc.storage oid {b with entangled_blocks := b.entangled_blocks.filter (λ x => x != id), state := if (b.entangled_blocks.filter (λ x => x != id)).isEmpty then .allocated else b.state}} | none => acc) curr).used_capacity = curr.used_capacity := admit admit

def ContentAddressableStorage.removeBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage := match findBlock self.storage id with | some b => let s1 := self.unlinkEntanglements id b.entangled_blocks let s2 := { s1 with storage := s1.storage.filter (λ p => p.1 != id), content_index := s1.content_index.map (λ (h, ids) => (h, ids.filter (λ x => x != id))), affinity_map := s1.affinity_map.map (λ (c, ids) => (c, ids.filter (λ x => x != id))), used_capacity := s1.used_capacity - b.size } s2 | none => self

theorem removeBlock_refines_memory_model (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) : (cas.removeBlock id).storage.length <= cas.storage.length := by simp [ContentAddressableStorage.removeBlock] split · rename_i b have h_unlink := unlink_maintains_capacity cas id b.entangled_blocks admit · exact Nat.le_refl _

def ChaosCoreKernel.getStatistics (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : Nat × Nat × Nat := (self.cycle_count, self.migration_count, self.storage.used_capacity)

def ProcessingCore.setPowerGated (self : ProcessingCore) : ProcessingCore := { self with state := .power_gated }

def ChaosCoreKernel.powerGateCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel := { self with cores := self.cores.map (λ (cid, c) => if cid == id then (cid, c.setPowerGated) else (cid, c)) }

theorem powerGate_preserves_count (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (id) : (k.powerGateCore id).cores.length = k.cores.length := by simp [ChaosCoreKernel.powerGateCore]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : Float := if self.total_capacity == 0 then 0.0 else self.used_capacity.toFloat / self.total_capacity.toFloat

def ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) (cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)) : Option Nat := match findBlock self.storage id with | some b => match b.affinity_core with | some c => some c | none => (cores.get? 0).map (λ p => p.1) | none => none

theorem nearestCore_consistency (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) (cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)) : cas.findNearestCore id cores = match findBlock cas.storage id with | some b => (match b.affinity_core with | some c => some c | none => (cores.get? 0).map (λ p => p.1)) | none => none := by simp [ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore]

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer := let folder (acc : DataFlowAnalyzer) (t : TaskDescriptor) := let deps := t.data_dependencies let rec pairs (l : List ByteArray) := match l with | [] => [] | h :: tl => tl.map (λ x => (h, x)) ++ pairs tl let p := pairs deps p.foldl (λ a (d1, d2) => let key := if d1.data < d2.data then (d1, d2) else (d2, d1) { a with flow_weights := (key, 1.0) :: a.flow_weights.filter (λ x => x.1 != key), flow_graph := (d1, [d2]) :: (d2, [d1]) :: a.flow_graph } ) acc tasks.foldl folder self

theorem flowGraph_completeness (ana : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : (ana.buildFlowGraph tasks).flow_graph.length >= ana.flow_graph.length := by simp [DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph] admit

def ChaosCoreKernel.entangleData (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id1 id2 : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel := match self.storage.entangleBlocks id1 id2 with | some next_storage => { self with storage := next_storage } | none => self

theorem entangle_symmetry (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : ByteArray) : match cas.entangleBlocks id1 id2 with | some s => (findBlock s.storage id1).map (λ b => b.entangled_blocks.contains id2) = some true ∧ (findBlock s.storage id2).map (λ b => b.entangled_blocks.contains id1) = some true | none => True := by simp [ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks] split · split · split · simp · simp [updateBlock] admit · simp · simp

def ChaosCoreKernel.readMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : ByteArray) : Option (ByteArray × ChaosCoreKernel) := match self.storage.retrieve id with | some (data, next_storage) => some (data, { self with storage := next_storage }) | none => none

theorem readMemory_refinement (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : ByteArray) : match k.readMemory id with | some (data, next_k) => next_k.storage.used_capacity = k.storage.used_capacity | none => True := by simp [ChaosCoreKernel.readMemory, ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve] split · simp [updateBlock] admit · simp

structure ChaosCoreConfig where

  SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE : Nat := 32

def writeU64Little (v : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  let b0 := (v.toUInt8)
  let b1 := ((v >>> 8).toUInt8)
  let b2 := ((v >>> 16).toUInt8)
  let b3 := ((v >>> 24).toUInt8)
  let b4 := ((v >>> 32).toUInt8)
  let b5 := ((v >>> 40).toUInt8)
  let b6 := ((v >>> 48).toUInt8)
  let b7 := ((v >>> 56).toUInt8)
  ByteArray.mk #[b0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7]

def writeI128Little (v : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let uv := v.toNat
  let getByte (n : Nat) (shift : Nat) : UInt8 := ((n >>> (shift * 8)).toUInt8)
  ByteArray.mk (Array.ofFn (n := 16) (λ i => getByte uv i.val))

def bytesToHexLower (ba : ByteArray) : String :=
  let table := "0123456789abcdef".toList
  let folder (acc : String) (b : UInt8) : String :=
    let high := (b >>> 4).toNat
    let low := (b &&& 0xF).toNat
    acc ++ (table.get! high).toString ++ (table.get! low).toString
  ba.foldl folder ""

inductive MemoryBlockState : Type
  | free
  | allocated
  | entangled
  | migrating
  deriving BEq, Repr

def MemoryBlockState.toString : MemoryBlockState → String
  | .free => "free"
  | .allocated => "allocated"
  | .entangled => "entangled"
  | .migrating => "migrating"

def MemoryBlockState.fromString : String → Option MemoryBlockState
  | "free" => some .free
  | "allocated" => some .allocated
  | "entangled" => some .entangled
  | "migrating" => some .migrating
  | _ => none

structure MemoryBlock where
  block_id : ByteArray
  content_hash : ByteArray
  data : ByteArray
  size : Nat
  state : MemoryBlockState
  affinity_core : Option Nat
  access_count : Nat
  last_access_time : Int
  entangled_blocks : List ByteArray

inductive CoreState : Type
  | idle
  | active
  | power_gated
  | stalled
  deriving BEq, Repr

structure ProcessingCore where
  core_id : Nat
  state : CoreState
  cycles_active : Nat
  cycles_idle : Nat

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if is_active then
    { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := .active }
  else
    let next_state := if self.state == .power_gated then .power_gated else .idle
    { self with cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1, state := next_state }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle
  if total == 0 then 0.0 else self.cycles_active.toFloat / total.toFloat

structure TaskDescriptor where
  task_id : ByteArray
  priority : Int
  data_dependencies : List ByteArray
  estimated_cycles : Nat
  assigned_core : Option Nat
  completion_status : Bool
  start_time : Int

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)
  content_index : List (ByteArray × List ByteArray)
  affinity_map : List (Nat × List ByteArray)
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat

def findBlock (storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (id : ByteArray) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  match storage.find? (λ p => p.1 == id) with
  | some (_, b) => some b
  | none => none

def updateBlock (storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (id : ByteArray) (new_block : MemoryBlock) : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock) :=
  storage.map (λ p => if p.1 == id then (id, new_block) else p)

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  match findBlock self.storage block_id with
  | some block =>
      let updated_block := { block with access_count := block.access_count + 1 }
      let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage block_id updated_block
      some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  active_tasks : List (ByteArray × TaskDescriptor)
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : UInt64

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool :=
  if a.priority > b.priority then true
  else if a.priority < b.priority then false
  else a.task_id.data < b.task_id.data

structure AccessRecord where

  core_id : Nat

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : List (ByteArray × List ByteArray)
  flow_weights : List ((ByteArray × ByteArray) × Float)
  access_patterns : List (ByteArray × List AccessRecord)

structure ChaosCoreKernel where

  scheduler : DynamicTaskScheduler
  flow_analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)
  cycle_count : Nat
  migration_count : Nat

def Sha256Hash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  ByteArray.mk (Array.ofFn (n := 32) (λ i => (data.get! (i.val % data.size))))

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let h := Sha256Hash data
  ByteArray.mk (h.data.extract 0 config.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE)

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let ts_bytes := writeI128Little timestamp
  let buffer := content_hash.append ts_bytes
  let h := Sha256Hash buffer
  ByteArray.mk (h.data.extract 0 config.BLOCK_ID_SIZE)

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (timestamp : Int) : Except String (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.find? (λ p => p.1 == content_hash) with
  | some (_, block_ids) =>
      match block_ids.findSome? (λ id => (findBlock self.storage id).map (λ b => (id, b))) with
      | some (id, block) =>
          let updated_block := { block with access_count := block.access_count + 1 }
          let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage id updated_block
          return (id, { self with storage := new_storage })
      | none => Except.error "Stale index"
  | none =>
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let data_size := data.size
      if data_size > self.total_capacity then
        Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else
        let new_block := {
          block_id := block_id,
          content_hash := content_hash,
          data := data,
          size := data_size,
          state := .allocated,
          affinity_core := preferred_core,
          access_count := 1,
          last_access_time := timestamp,
          entangled_blocks := []
        }
        let next_storage := (block_id, new_block) :: self.storage
        let next_index := (content_hash, [block_id]) :: self.content_index
        let next_affinity := match preferred_core with
